evidence.observation: H701 temperature reads 388.867 °C, far above the other heater temperatures near 58 °C.
T701 has risen to 396.4 °C while T702 remains 57.7 °C and the reboiler vessel T703 remains 52.77 °C; the isolated high reading requires verification.
Other heaters remain 57.8–57.9 °C, system pressure is 299.88 mbar and column differential pressure is -0.32 mbar, without a corresponding broad process excursion.

args.missing_evidence: H701 setpoint, permitted temperature range, power output and independent temperature verification are needed to distinguish actual overheating from a sensor/readout fault; no composition measurement or separation acceptance criterion is provided.
